title: An Email to a Pen Friend
description: Practise questions, present perfect and will, then write an email to a new pen friend.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your email in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: Choose the best way to start an email.
exercises.explanation: We start an email to a friend with "Dear" + name, or "Hi" + name.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
exercises.text: ✉️ My name is Linh and I ___ (live) in Da Nang.
exercises.explanation: Use the base verb with "I": I live.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.explanation: We use "Where" to ask about a place.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: I go to school by bus.
exercises.explanation: Subject + verb + to + place + by + transport: I go to school by bus.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: My brother have a little cat.
answers: My brother has a little cat.
exercises.explanation: With he, she or it, use "has" (not "have").

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.explanation: Present perfect: have/has + past participle. "I have never been" talks about my life so far.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
exercises.explanation: Present perfect = have + past participle. The past participle of visit is visited.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: Write soon! I ___ answer your email quickly.
exercises.explanation: Use "will" for a promise about the future.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: I like playing chess with my grandfather.
exercises.explanation: Like + verb-ing: I like playing chess with my grandfather.

exercises.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word GOING. Begin: "I ..."
exercises.text: I will visit my aunt next weekend.
answers: I am going to visit my aunt next weekend.
I'm going to visit my aunt next weekend.
exercises.explanation: "Going to" talks about plans: I am going to visit.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: My birthday is ___ the fifth of June.
exercises.explanation: Use "on" with dates and days: on the fifth of June.

exercises.prompt: Write who, which or where.
exercises.text: I have got a friend ___ lives in Canada.
exercises.explanation: Use "who" for people.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Hanoi is more big than my small town.
answers: Hanoi is bigger than my small town.
exercises.explanation: Short adjectives take -er: big - bigger (not "more big").

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: Last summer we ___ to the beach.
exercises.explanation: "Go" is irregular. The past simple is "went".

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: What do you do after school.
What do you do after school?
exercises.explanation: Question word + do + subject + verb: What do you do after school?

exercises.prompt: Write should or shouldn't.
exercises.text: You ___ send me a photo of your family. I would love to see it!
exercises.explanation: "Should" gives a suggestion.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: I like football, ___ I am not very good at it.
exercises.explanation: "But" joins two different ideas.

exercises.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word BIGGER. Begin: "Your ..."
exercises.text: My town is smaller than your town.
answers: Your town is bigger than my town.
Your town is bigger than mine.
exercises.explanation: "A is smaller than B" means "B is bigger than A".

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Yesterday I writed a long email to Tom.
answers: Yesterday I wrote a long email to Tom.
exercises.explanation: "Write" is irregular. The past simple is "wrote".

exercises.prompt: Complete the end of the email.
exercises.explanation: We often close an email with "Best wishes".

task.prompt: You have got a new pen friend called Sam. Write him an email. Tell him about yourself.
contentPoints: Say your name and where you live.
Say what you are going to do at the weekend.
usefulLanguage: My name is ... and I live in ...
At the weekend I am going to ...
task.modelAnswer:
Dear Sam,

Hello! My name is Mai and I live in Hue. I am eleven years old. I like swimming and reading books because they are fun. At the weekend I am going to visit my grandmother. We will make a big cake together. What do you like doing? Have you got any brothers or sisters?

Write soon!
Mai
